stepAnswer: The model risk increases because the observational variance increases.
stepBody: Turns out the dataset provider assumed that consumers were truthful on the survey. However, a follow up study found that most consumers lied about their answers. How does the model risk change and why?
choices: The model risk increases because the model bias increases.
The model risk increases because the model variance increases.
The model risk increases because the observational variance increases.
The model risk decreases because the model bias decreases.
The model risk decreases because the model variance decreases.
The model risk decreases because the observational variance decreases.
The model risk stays the same because the lying consumers have no effect on model bias, model variance, or observational variance.
